evidence/body.text: Sure, before we go to 10-20, we need to do 1-2.  Regarding the "enactment rung" — can we please TURN THIS OFF?  The whole point of the War Machine is that it's automatic and self-evidencing.  The one thing I am interested in engaging with are the Arxana Field Desk QA notes so that I can get a good sense of whether the machine is actually achieving useful work.  That's the only meaningful time for gating at this level, delivery, not strategy.
